title: Musk Says Grok Bot’s Costs Were ‘Unsustainably High’ Weeks After Touting Rapid Growth
summary: The billionaire’s remarks come less than two weeks after SpaceX revealed the AI agent had reached 800,000 paid weekly users in early October, more than double the previous month.
